springboot_notes.onnx: Recommended package uses self-contained ONNX files. Load from filesystem path with ONNX Runtime Java. No .onnx.data should be required when manifest onnx_mode=self_contained_onnx.
springboot_notes.xgboost: Use XGBoost4J or compatible JSON/UBJ loader.
springboot_notes.lightgbm: Use Java LightGBM predictor compatible with text model.
springboot_notes.catboost: Use CatBoost Java runtime for CBM if enabled.
springboot_notes.oneclasssvm: Use provided JSON and RBF formula.
springboot_notes.extratrees: Use provided JSON manual tree traversal.
